program.section_heading: Geography - Associate in Arts for Transfer (ADT) - AA759 (CalGETC)
outcomes: Explain why the environment, culture, and society change so much from place to place, and use that knowledge to navigate life and career
Identify and understand critical environmental, cultural, and social issues and challenges existing at a range of scales
Explain the key environmental, cultural, and social challenges of the past, present, and future in terms of fundamental geographic, physical, and social science processes and concepts.
Use information resources, field equipment, spatial technology and map data to research and identify various ways of understanding geographic patterns, challenges, problems, and solutions

blocks.name: Required Courses - Select one of the following

notes: The catalog prints 'Units: 7.00' for the Required Courses heading as a whole; it was split into a required block (GEG-1 or honors GEG-1H, plus GEG-1L) and a choose-one block (GEG-2 or GEG-3). The 7.00 total is not recorded on either block's stated.

GEG-1 and GEG-1H were printed under 'Select one of the following'; they are recorded as one entry with the honors twin as an alternative. GEG-1L is read as required, consistent with the 7.00-unit total (3+1+3).

List A allows 'any course not used in Required Courses' in addition to the listed courses. List B allows 'any course not used in Required Courses or List A'. List C allows 'any course not used in Required Courses, List A, or List B'. These pathways are not recorded as blocks.
GEG-5 and PHS-5 are printed under 'Only one of the following may be used'; they are recorded as one entry with an alternative.
Several courses are marked '( Historical )' in the catalog: GEG-4, GEG-30A, GEG-7, GEG-6 and GEO-1. A reviewer should check whether they are still offered.

The page repeats the heading for AA759 (CalGETC) and also prints a heading 'AA758 (CSUGE)/ AA759 (IGETC)'. That heading may be left over from an earlier catalog year. The degree text names Cal-GETC as the GE pattern.
The catalog titles GEG-6 'Geography of the United States and Canada'; the closed list titles it 'Geography of United States and Canada'.
